description: The record of the model layer: primary model, escalation rule, fallback, pinned versions and cost projection, with the forces, alternatives and consequences behind them.
A requirement that removes candidates outright (data residency, latency budget), as opposed to soft criteria that rank what is left.
The implementable part of the decision: which model answers first, when to escalate and to what, which model takes over in an outage, and the projected monthly cost.
Volume × per-call cost of the primary, plus escalation rate × per-call cost of the escalation model, plus fixed hosting costs.
Using dated model ids instead of `-latest` aliases, so behavior changes only with a deliberate, evaluated deploy.
